messages.subject: Project Lyra — mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Good to be working opposite you again. Attached is a mutual confidentiality agreement for the proposed HRX-218 licence — fairly standard, 18-month term and 5-year tail. If your client is content we'd suggest signing this week so the data room can open.

Kind regards,
James

--
James Osei | Senior Associate, Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Likewise. The NDA is fine in principle — Calderbrook would just like the non-solicit shortened to 12 months (already 12 in your draft, so no change needed) and confirmation that their patent attorneys count as Permitted Recipients. We read clause 1 as covering that. On that basis Dr Brandt will sign today.

Oliver
